name: Virginia permits: second reading
what_was_checked: All 182 readable permits on DEQ's statewide list of datacenter air permits
method: Re-read by a second method that shares no code with the first; every permit read by eye with hand re-summation; disagreements resolved against the permit text
checker: second reader working separately from the first
result: The first reading agreed with the text in 24 permits; 107 disagreed (the first reading low in 98), 22 differed slightly and 29 gave no figure. Eight error patterns were found, the largest a first row dropped after each table header (70 permits). Resolved total 33,693 MW for 182 permits; the first reading gave 19,186 MW for 153, which resolve to 30,867 MW. The fixed parser agrees with the resolved figures on 178 of 182, a test of the parser, not a third reading.

name: Hostile methodology review of the handover
what_was_checked: The brief, the Ireland regional check, the five worked rows, the dedicated-supply column and the method
method: A reviewer taking the stance of a methodology lead looking for a reason to set the package aside
result: 36 findings: 4 blocked sending, 18 to fix before sending, 10 caveats, 4 fine. The five worked rows were withdrawn; the Ireland check became a table of bounds; the supply column was reclassified.

name: Final review of the package and brief
what_was_checked: The brief against every file in the handover, the Virginia re-read and the Virginia entries
method: Same sceptical reviewer, second pass
result: 37 findings: 4 blocked sending, 16 to fix before sending, 14 caveats, 3 fine.

name: Review of the public ledger page
what_was_checked: The page as built: 117 entries, the themes, the standard, the receipts and the method
method: Sceptical reviewer reading the page as a Climate TRACE reader would
result: 51 findings: 5 blocked linking the page, 27 to fix before sending, 12 caveats, 7 fine; the page's own prose said more than the entries.

name: Texas figures against their documents

name: EPA inventory facilities outside Virginia: what and where each is
what_was_checked: The 71 facilities outside Virginia that states classed under NAICS 518210 in EPA's 2020 and 2023 emissions inventories, as the weekly pull of 2026-10-26 returned them: whether each is a datacenter, where it is, who holds the permit, and whether it is a site the ledger already lists
method: Three readers, each with a group of states, searched for state air permits, county and municipal records, then company pages and press, without using the ledger; the Texas facilities were matched by EPA's facility registry

name: Irish licences not in the ledger's list
what_was_checked: The 15 licence numbers the weekly pull's search of the EPA's licensing system listed as not in the ledger's watch list of licensed datacentres
method: A reader looked for the EPA's own documents for each number (applications, determinations, inspector's reports, notices) and recorded licensee, address, status, what is licensed and whether it is a datacentre
applied_in: sites/ireland_sites.json, registry/europe.json, registry/guide.json, data/climate_trace_seed/METERED.md, README.md, ROADMAP.md, sites/chain/README.md, scrapers/pull_ie_aer.py

name: EPA inventory facilities outside Virginia: second search for the unidentified
what_was_checked: The 23 facilities the first search (us-nei-identity-check-2026-11-02) could not identify
method: A reader searched state air permits, county and city records, SEC filings, then company pages and press, without using the ledger

name: State evaluations of datacenter tax incentives, read twice
what_was_checked: 62 figures from 24 official documents on datacenter tax incentives in Minnesota, Washington, Illinois, Ohio, Texas, Arizona, Indiana, Oklahoma, North Carolina, South Carolina, Nebraska, Michigan, Nevada and Oregon
method: A first reader found the documents and took the figures; a second reader, given only the documents and what to look for, read them again; the two readings were compared figure by figure
selection: the figures chosen for the ledger from the first reading

name: UK records on datacentres, read twice
what_was_checked: 814 figures and facts from 170 UK documents: Environment Agency and Natural Resources Wales permits for datacentre standby generators, the West London electricity constraint, planning decisions 2023 to 2026, national demand estimates (NESO, Ofgem, Parliament), the datacentre Climate Change Agreement, water companies' plans, and public money for AI compute
method: Three first readers found the documents and took the figures; four second readers, given only the documents and what to look for, read them again; the two readings were compared item by item, and a figure enters only where they agree
selection: every item the first readers took, except stack heights, fuel storage and per-generator ratings

name: Organisation identifiers and group links, read twice
what_was_checked: LEIs, SEC CIKs and Wikidata items for 53 organisations (99 identifiers); documents stating which group a project company or national subsidiary belongs to (47 links, US, Irish and UK companies)
method: A first reader found each identifier or link on a register, filing or other document; a second reader, given only the page or document and the pair of names, read it again; only identifiers and links on which both agree enter the ledger
selection: the largest groups in the site register, and the companies named at their sites

name: The graph's links against their documents
what_was_checked: Whether figures, operators, places, chain links and publishers in the graph are what their documents state; and every name mapped to an organisation, compared with the organisation's name
method: 52 links drawn at random by kind; a reader who had not built the graph answered from each document without being shown the ledger's value; where the reader could not open a document, the maintainer read it the same way; name mappings compared by script and read by hand
checker: an independent reader, and the maintainer for documents the reader could not open
selection: random, stratified by kind of link; ownership links excluded (read twice in their own round)

name: Where the UK sites are, read twice
what_was_checked: The grid reference, easting and northing, coordinates or address each UK site's documents give
method: two readers per site, independently, from the permits, decisions and reports the ledger cites (or the official record of the same site); placed where both give the same point, converted by pipeline/osgb.py and checked against the town the documents name

name: Where the unplaced sites are, read twice
what_was_checked: Coordinates, street address or description each unplaced site's documents give: crypto and conversion sites, fabs, nuclear plants, and datacentres in Ireland, Singapore, the UK and Texas (185 sites)
method: two readers per site, independently, from the documents the ledger cites (or an official record of the same site); coordinates placed where both agree; addresses both give added to the site's notes, US ones queued for the Census geocoder
selection: every unplaced site outside the benchmarking, Virginia permit and refiner lists

name: Where the unplaced sites are: second pass
what_was_checked: Coordinates or street address for the Texas and Irish sites, the planned nuclear sites, and second readings of first-pass leads (47 sites)
method: two readers per site, independently, held to two searches per site, from regulators' notices, permits and case documents; placed where both give the same point; addresses both give added to notes, US ones queued for the Census geocoder
selection: the unplaced sites where official records usually give coordinates
